description: 5 exemplars + 4 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Authored under road-to-a-film-built-from-time 5.3. Exemplars are films built from code: launch clip, kinetic type, animated chart, brand loop, explainer (German). Near-misses carry the routing the skill must give away: generative-provider prompts (motion-choreographer), UI motion (fe-design), editing footage (/video). The counterexample is a single animated asset (svg-authoring).
